method.name: Graphic3d_Aspects
method.description: Creates a context table for drawing primitives defined with the following default values:

method.name: InteriorStyle
method.description: Return interior rendering style; Aspect_IS_SOLID by default.

method.name: SetInteriorStyle
method.description: Modifies the interior type used for rendering

method.name: ShadingModel
method.description: Returns shading model; Graphic3d_TypeOfShadingModel_DEFAULT by default. Graphic3d_TOSM_DEFAULT means that Shading Model set as default for entire Viewer will be used.

method.name: SetShadingModel
method.description: Sets shading model

method.name: AlphaMode
method.description: Returns the way how alpha value should be treated (Graphic3d_AlphaMode_BlendAuto by default, for backward compatibility).

method.name: AlphaCutoff
method.description: Returns alpha cutoff threshold, for discarding fragments within Graphic3d_AlphaMode_Mask mode (0.5 by default). If the alpha value is greater than or equal to this value then it is rendered as fully opaque, otherwise, it is rendered as fully transparent.

method.name: SetAlphaMode
method.description: Defines the way how alpha value should be treated.

method.name: ColorRGBA
method.description: Return color

method.name: Color
method.description: Return the color.

method.name: SetColor
method.description: Modifies the color.

method.name: InteriorColor
method.description: Return interior color.

method.name: InteriorColorRGBA
method.description: Return interior color.

method.name: SetInteriorColor_1
method.description: Modifies the color of the interior of the face

method.name: SetInteriorColor_2
method.description: Modifies the color of the interior of the face

method.name: BackInteriorColor
method.description: Return back interior color.

method.name: BackInteriorColorRGBA
method.description: Return back interior color.

method.name: SetBackInteriorColor_1
method.description: Modifies the color of the interior of the back face

method.name: SetBackInteriorColor_2
method.description: Modifies the color of the interior of the back face

method.name: FrontMaterial
method.description: Returns the surface material of external faces

method.name: ChangeFrontMaterial
method.description: Returns the surface material of external faces

method.name: SetFrontMaterial
method.description: Modifies the surface material of external faces

method.name: BackMaterial
method.description: Returns the surface material of internal faces

method.name: ChangeBackMaterial
method.description: Returns the surface material of internal faces

method.name: SetBackMaterial
method.description: Modifies the surface material of internal faces

method.name: FaceCulling
method.description: Return face culling mode; Graphic3d_FaceCulling_BackClosed by default. A back-facing polygon is defined as a polygon whose vertices are in a clockwise order with respect to screen coordinates.

method.name: SetFaceCulling
method.description: Set face culling mode.

method.name: Distinguish
method.description: Returns true if material properties should be distinguished for back and front faces (false by default).

method.name: SetDistinguish
method.description: Set material distinction between front and back faces.

method.name: SetDistinguishOn
method.description: Allows material distinction between front and back faces.

method.name: SetDistinguishOff
method.description: Forbids material distinction between front and back faces.

method.name: ShaderProgram
method.description: Return shader program.

method.name: SetShaderProgram
method.description: Sets up OpenGL/GLSL shader program.

method.name: TextureSet
method.description: Return texture array to be mapped.

method.name: SetTextureSet
method.description: Setup texture array to be mapped.

method.name: TextureMap
method.description: Return texture to be mapped.

method.name: SetTextureMap
method.description: Assign texture to be mapped. See also SetTextureMapOn() to actually activate texture mapping.

method.name: ToMapTexture
method.description: Return true if texture mapping is enabled (false by default).

method.name: TextureMapState
method.description: Return true if texture mapping is enabled (false by default).

method.name: SetTextureMapOn_2
method.description: Enable or disable texture mapping (has no effect if texture is not set).

method.name: SetTextureMapOn_1
method.description: Enable texture mapping (has no effect if texture is not set).

method.name: SetTextureMapOff
method.description: Disable texture mapping.

method.name: PolygonOffset
method.description: Returns current polygon offsets settings.

method.name: SetPolygonOffset
method.description: Sets polygon offsets settings.

method.name: PolygonOffsets
method.description: Returns current polygon offsets settings.

method.name: SetPolygonOffsets
method.description: Sets up OpenGL polygon offsets mechanism. <aMode> parameter can contain various combinations of Aspect_PolygonOffsetMode enumeration elements (Aspect_POM_None means that polygon offsets are not changed). If <aMode> is different from Aspect_POM_Off and Aspect_POM_None, then <aFactor> and <aUnits> arguments are used by graphic renderer to calculate a depth offset value:

method.name: LineType
method.description: Return line type; Aspect_TOL_SOLID by default.

method.name: SetLineType
method.description: Modifies the line type

method.name: LinePattern
method.description: Return custom stipple line pattern; 0xFFFF by default.

method.name: SetLinePattern
method.description: Modifies the stipple line pattern, and changes line type to Aspect_TOL_USERDEFINED for non-standard pattern.

method.name: LineStippleFactor
method.description: Return a multiplier for each bit in the line stipple pattern within [1, 256] range; 1 by default.

method.name: SetLineStippleFactor
method.description: Set a multiplier for each bit in the line stipple pattern.

method.name: LineWidth
method.description: Return width for edges in pixels; 1.0 by default.

method.name: SetLineWidth
method.description: Modifies the line thickness Warning: Raises Standard_OutOfRange if the width is a negative value.

method.name: MarkerType
method.description: Return marker type; Aspect_TOM_POINT by default.

method.name: SetMarkerType
method.description: Modifies the type of marker.

method.name: MarkerScale
method.description: Return marker scale factor; 1.0 by default.

method.name: SetMarkerScale
method.description: Modifies the scale factor. Marker type Aspect_TOM_POINT is not affected by the marker size scale factor. It is always the smallest displayable dot. Warning: Raises Standard_OutOfRange if the scale is a negative value.

method.name: MarkerImage
method.description: Returns marker's image texture. Could be null handle if marker aspect has been initialized as default type of marker.

method.name: SetMarkerImage
method.description: Set marker's image texture.

method.name: IsMarkerSprite
method.description: Returns TRUE if marker should be drawn using marker sprite (either user-provided or generated).

method.name: TextFont
method.description: Returns the font; NULL string by default.

method.name: SetTextFont
method.description: Modifies the font.

method.name: TextFontAspect
method.description: Returns text FontAspect

method.name: SetTextFontAspect
method.description: Turns usage of Aspect text

method.name: TextDisplayType
method.description: Returns display type; Aspect_TODT_NORMAL by default.

method.name: SetTextDisplayType
method.description: Sets display type.

method.name: ColorSubTitleRGBA
method.description: Returns text background/shadow color; equals to EdgeColor() property.

method.name: ColorSubTitle
method.description: Return text background/shadow color; equals to EdgeColor() property.

method.name: SetColorSubTitle_1
method.description: Modifies text background/shadow color; equals to EdgeColor() property.

method.name: SetColorSubTitle_2
method.description: Modifies text background/shadow color; equals to EdgeColor() property.

method.name: IsTextZoomable
method.description: Returns TRUE when the Text Zoomable is on.

method.name: SetTextZoomable
method.description: Turns usage of text zoomable on/off

method.name: TextStyle
method.description: Returns the text style; Aspect_TOST_NORMAL by default.

method.name: SetTextStyle
method.description: Modifies the style of the text.

method.name: TextAngle
method.description: Returns Angle of degree

method.name: SetTextAngle
method.description: Turns usage of text rotated

method.name: ToDrawEdges
method.description: Returns true if mesh edges should be drawn (false by default).

method.name: SetDrawEdges
method.description: Set if mesh edges should be drawn or not.

method.name: SetEdgeOn
method.description: The edges of FillAreas are drawn.

method.name: SetEdgeOff
method.description: The edges of FillAreas are not drawn.

method.name: EdgeColor
method.description: Return color of edges.

method.name: EdgeColorRGBA
method.description: Return color of edges.

method.name: SetEdgeColor_1
method.description: Modifies the color of the edge of the face

method.name: SetEdgeColor_2
method.description: Modifies the color of the edge of the face

method.name: EdgeLineType
method.description: Return edges line type (same as LineType()).

method.name: SetEdgeLineType
method.description: Modifies the edge line type (same as SetLineType())

method.name: EdgeWidth
method.description: Return width for edges in pixels (same as LineWidth()).

method.name: SetEdgeWidth
method.description: Modifies the edge thickness (same as SetLineWidth())

method.name: ToSkipFirstEdge
method.description: Returns TRUE if drawing element edges should discard first edge in triangle; FALSE by default. Graphics hardware works mostly with triangles, so that wireframe presentation will draw triangle edges by default. This flag allows rendering wireframe presentation of quad-only array split into triangles. For this, quads should be split in specific order, so that the quad diagonal (to be NOT rendered) goes first: 1------2 / / Triangle #1: 2-0-1; Triangle #2: 0-2-3 0------3

method.name: SetSkipFirstEdge
method.description: Set skip first triangle edge flag for drawing wireframe presentation of quads array split into triangles.

method.name: ToDrawSilhouette
method.description: Returns TRUE if silhouette (outline) should be drawn (with edge color and width); FALSE by default.

method.name: SetDrawSilhouette
method.description: Enables/disables drawing silhouette (outline).

method.name: HatchStyle
method.description: Returns the hatch type used when InteriorStyle is IS_HATCH

method.name: SetHatchStyle_1
method.description: Modifies the hatch type used when InteriorStyle is IS_HATCH

method.name: SetHatchStyle_2
method.description: Modifies the hatch type used when InteriorStyle is IS_HATCH

method.name: IsEqual
method.description: Check for equality with another aspects.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: DefaultLinePatternForType
method.description: Return stipple line pattern for line type.

method.name: DefaultLineTypeForPattern
method.description: Return line type for stipple line pattern.
